title: Find the full name and age of the youngest driver who achieved the best lap
question: Find the full name and age of the youngest driver who achieved the best lap time in any Monaco Grand Prix race. Also provide the race year when this record was set.

prediction.sql:
WITH monaco_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        r.XCL_066 AS race_year,
        lt.XCL_048 AS lap_time_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
),
best_lap AS (
    SELECT MIN(lap_time_ms) AS min_lap_time_ms
    FROM monaco_laps
),
best_lap_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ml.driver_id, ml.race_year
    FROM monaco_laps AS ml
    CROSS JOIN best_lap AS bl
    WHERE ml.lap_time_ms = bl.min_lap_time_ms
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    bld.race_year
FROM best_lap_drivers AS bld
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON bld.driver_id = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monaco_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        r.XCL_066 AS race_year,
        lt.XCL_048 AS lap_time_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
),
best_lap AS (
    SELECT MIN(lap_time_ms) AS min_lap_time_ms
    FROM monaco_laps
),
best_lap_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ml.driver_id, ml.race_year
    FROM monaco_laps AS ml
    CROSS JOIN best_lap AS bl
    WHERE ml.lap_time_ms = bl.min_lap_time_ms
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    bld.race_year
FROM best_lap_drivers AS bld
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON bld.driver_id = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monaco_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        r.XCL_066 AS race_year,
        lt.XCL_048 AS lap_time_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
),
best_lap AS (
    SELECT MIN(lap_time_ms) AS min_lap_time_ms
    FROM monaco_laps
),
best_lap_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ml.driver_id, ml.race_year
    FROM monaco_laps AS ml
    CROSS JOIN best_lap AS bl
    WHERE ml.lap_time_ms = bl.min_lap_time_ms
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    bld.race_year
FROM best_lap_drivers AS bld
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON bld.driver_id = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T3."XCL_038", T3."XCL_039", T3."XCL_036", T1."XCL_066"
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2."XCL_074" = T1."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_075"
WHERE T1."XCL_069" = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND T2."XCL_084" IS NOT NULL
  AND T2."XCL_084" != ''
  AND T2."XCL_084" = (
      SELECT MIN(T2b."XCL_084")
      FROM races AS T1b
      INNER JOIN results AS T2b ON T2b."XCL_074" = T1b."XCL_065"
      WHERE T1b."XCL_069" = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
        AND T2b."XCL_084" IS NOT NULL
        AND T2b."XCL_084" != ''
  )
ORDER BY T3."XCL_036" ASC
LIMIT 1
